method_notes: Research 29 Sep 2026. Web actions: about 22 across both batches, reusing STRAITREP/MPA sources across TSS-0146 to TSS-0152. Sector allocation for Singapore sectors is by MPA-stated longitudes; for Malaysian sectors 1-6 by inspection of the MPA Appendix 1 chartlet against SPI 2026 WGS 84 coordinates (boundaries not published as coordinates). Marine Department Malaysia site (marine.gov.my) returned HTTP 503 via WebFetch and a TLS chain error via curl, so the Malaysian operating body rests on a news lead only. The region notes mention Vietnam (Vung Tau) but no Vietnamese TSS is in group U; TSS-0155 is the Hong Kong Tathong Channel scheme and was researched as such. SUNDAREP and LOMBOKREP are recorded as mandatory reporting 'Yes' with applicability limited to Indonesian-flag ships and no VRS ID (not in IMO Part I); the coordinator may prefer to allocate national VRS IDs or to treat them differently. No repository files were edited.
